newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 15 killed in latest Colombian violence.
newsitem.headline: At least 15 killed in latest Colombian violence.

text.p: At least 15 people were killed in shootings across Colombia on Wednesday night and Thursday morning, as the country's spiral of violence continued unabated.
Police said the victims included four men who gunmen dragged from a truck and shot dead before fleeing in the pre-dawn darkness near a remote town in southwest Huila province.
The victims -- a local discotheque owner, his son and two employees -- were stopped at a roadblock and each shot twice in the head in an revenge killing, the police said.
In another incident, four men and two females were gunned down in Rionegro, a town in Colombia's violence-torn northwest province of Antioquia, police spokesmen said.
They said one of the victims had served time for homicide and had recently been released from prison.
In Antioquia's banana-growing region of Uraba, meanwhile, local media reported that at least five people were victims of execution-syle murders overnight.
Colombia has one of the world's highest murder rates. Police said more than 26.640 killings across the country last year alone.
